title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Role & responsibilities We are looking for an experienced and strategic Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the company's technology vision, engineering strategy, technical operations, and innovation initiatives. The CTO will be responsible for building and scaling high-performing engineering teams, defining technology architecture and standards, overseeing software delivery and cloud infrastructure, strengthening cybersecurity, and ensuring that technology investments are aligned with the company's business objectives. The ideal candidate should combine strong technical depth with business leadership , with experience managing complex software projects, cloud platforms, engineering teams, client-facing technology engagements, and enterprise-scale systems. 
 Preferred candidate profile Technology Strategy & Leadership Define and execute the company's short-term and long-term technology strategy in alignment with business objectives. Work closely with the Founder/CEO and leadership team on technology investments, product strategy, digital transformation, and organizational growth. Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve business efficiency, service offerings, and competitive positioning. Establish engineering standards, architecture principles, development methodologies, and technology governance. Build a technology roadmap supporting scalability, security, reliability, and future business expansion. Engineering & Software Delivery Provide leadership across software engineering, architecture, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, QA, and related technology functions. Oversee the architecture and delivery of web, mobile, cloud, SaaS, eCommerce, and enterprise applications. Ensure projects are delivered with appropriate standards for quality, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability. Establish effective code review, testing, CI/CD, release management, and deployment practices. Review critical technical designs and guide teams in resolving complex architecture and production challenges. Drive modernization of legacy systems and adoption of appropriate modern technologies. Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure Define the company's cloud and infrastructure strategy across platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . Oversee cloud architecture, Kubernetes/container environments, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and disaster recovery. Establish high availability, backup, business continuity, and disaster recovery standards. Optimize infrastructure performance and cloud expenditure while maintaining reliability and scalability. Promote Infrastructure as Code and automation using technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent platforms. Cybersecurity & Risk Management Establish and continuously improve the organization's cybersecurity framework. Ensure appropriate controls for application security, infrastructure security, identity and access management, data protection, vulnerability management, and incident response. Implement security practices throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Oversee technology risk assessments, security audits, penetration testing, backup policies, and disaster recovery exercises. Support compliance with applicable security, privacy, and client requirements. AI, Automation & Innovation Develop a practical strategy for adopting Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, automation, and data-driven technologies . Identify opportunities to incorporate AI into internal operations, software development, client solutions, and products. Evaluate new frameworks, platforms, tools, and technologies based on measurable business value rather than technology trends alone. Encourage experimentation and innovation while maintaining appropriate security and governance. Team Building & Engineering Culture Recruit, mentor, develop, and retain high-performing technology leaders and engineering professionals. Establish clear organizational structures, responsibilities, career paths, and performance expectations across technology teams. Mentor Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, Architects, DevOps Engineers, and senior developers. Build a culture focused on ownership, engineering excellence, continuous learning, collaboration, and accountability. Conduct technical leadership reviews and identify skill gaps and training requirements. Client & Stakeholder Management Participate in technical discussions with clients, prospects, partners, and internal stakeholders. Translate business requirements into appropriate technical solutions and architecture. Support pre-sales activities including solution architecture, technical estimations, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and technical presentations. Provide executive-level communication for critical projects, technical risks, security incidents, and technology transformation initiatives. Build confidence with enterprise clients through strong technical governance and delivery practices. Technology Governance & KPIs Establish measurable KPIs for engineering productivity, software quality, infrastructure reliability, security, project delivery, and technology costs. Monitor areas such as deployment frequency, production incidents, system availability, defect rates, security vulnerabilities, infrastructure expenditure, and delivery predictability. Conduct periodic architecture, security, infrastructure, and engineering reviews. Establish appropriate documentation and knowledge-management practices. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering , or a related discipline. 12+ years of overall technology experience , with significant experience in senior engineering or technology leadership positions. 5+ years of experience managing engineering teams, technical leaders, architects, or technology departments. Strong understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, microservices, databases, distributed systems, and enterprise application development. Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP . Good understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, observability, and DevOps practices . Understanding of modern frontend and backend technology ecosystems such as React/Next.js, Node.js, PHP/Laravel, .NET, Java, Python, or comparable technologies. Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, caching, messaging, and search technologies. Solid knowledge of cybersecurity, secure application development, infrastructure security, and data protection. Experience managing large-scale software projects and multiple engineering teams simultaneously.
